evidenceChecked: All seven scenes retain a single level-one heading, logical source order, ordinary Markdown structure, and text that remains meaningful without visual styling or interaction state.

The declarative third-variable diagram has concise alt text, a relationship-complete long description, labelled nodes and edges, and equivalent fork, chain, and collider relationships in prose and symbolic text.

Prompts can be answered by text, speech to a scribe, or labelled arrows; no required operation depends on color, hover, dragging, sound, animation, pointer precision, or a time limit, and assessment retakes remain untimed and unlimited.
The pack contains no raw HTML, HTML entities, Markdown images, remote embeds, executable code, unsafe URL schemes, or active media; its only diagram is inert pack-local JSON.

The clinical case and all numerical teaching cases are explicitly fictional, the clinical scene disclaims medical advice, and the pack contains no patient, learner, credential, secret, or other identifiable private data.

All six references record factual-reference use, facts-only original expression, concrete rights-basis evidence, displayed licence information, exact locators, dated access, and checked-no-agent-restriction-found status; no source is marked human-only.

The current NCBI policy page was rechecked for its copyright, source-specific permission, privacy, and scripted-access cautions; the lesson redistributes no source expression, article, table, figure, media, or dataset.

lesson.json declares CC BY 4.0 for course content and no third-party assets; ATTRIBUTION.md identifies the accountable principal, source-use boundary, original fictional material, original declarative diagram, agent assistance, and per-run provenance records.

The assigned scope prohibited reading site schemas, the graph, the terminology ledger, and the local quorum policy, so those external pack relationships and schema implementations were not independently inspected.

Repository npm validation and strict source preflight were not run because the operator explicitly prohibited npm; targeted JSON, reference-constraint, mapping, source-note, Markdown-safety, assessment, glossary, and diagram integrity checks passed.

Several PubMed routes presented automated-access challenges during the live audit. The finalizer verified the local dated access records, the reachable official records, and the current NCBI policy page but did not independently reprocess all six full articles.
The operator supplied the fact that both GitHub transports are non-dismissed COMMENTED reviews on pull request 92; this run did not independently inspect GitHub transport state.

rationale: The exact original candidate and both committed review artifacts were inspected. Their declared lesson identity, version, candidate commit, roles, verdicts, principals, signed times, agent runs, and providers yield two eligible standard review inputs: one academic request-changes and one learning-design approval across two distinct declared runs and model families. The finalizer run ID appears nowhere in the pack's authoring or review provenance. This is an internally consistent, operator-attested record, not proof of human or provider independence. Every finding is indexed above; all actionable academic and attribution defects were incorporated in one bounded revision, while the positive note findings required no change. The resulting pack preserves the approved instructional arc, corrects the health-framed evidence chain and causal overstatement, returns claims to the proper pending-review state, and satisfies the source-level accessibility and rights audit. Targeted integrity checks passed. The decision is merge subject to replacing the placeholder final commit and completing the repository checks reserved to the operator; it is not permission to publish or merge the pull request.
dissent: The academic reviewer requested changes to the original candidate because the clinical scene was outside the evidence map, its causal conclusion overstated an imprecise adjusted contrast, claim review states were premature, and attribution was stale. All four actionable findings are incorporated; the original request-changes verdict remains part of the record.

The learning-design reviewer approved but declared that github:VSBDev operated both authoring/packaging agents and that review agent. Founding-stage policy permits one accountable operator with isolated runs, but this record does not establish independent human review or independently verify the declared provider/model provenance.
conditions: The operator must commit the final lesson content with both cited review artifacts, replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character content commit, and make no teaching-content change after the recorded final commit.
Before merge, the maintainer must run the repository's required strict source preflight and validation because this run was explicitly instructed not to run npm.

Any publication transition remains limited to lesson status, source confidence, and retained claims' reviewStatus fields after the final commit is recorded; the maintainer must not treat this adjudication as publication or clinical approval.
